capabilities: Search books by title or ISBN across multiple providers with fallback
Download and cache book cover images into the vault
Create book notes from customizable frontmatter and body templates
Track reading status, ratings and progress as YAML properties
Browse the library as a card gallery or an Obsidian Base card view
extras: Not yet published to the Community Plugins directory; the README documents manual installation from a GitHub release. A roadmap lists future improvements such as better rate-limit messaging and additional providers.
intentEvidence: I tried a few existing community plugins for this first, and kept running into the same wall: broken searches, covers that never actually downloaded
motivation: The author wanted a native visual library of their books and found existing community plugins had broken searches, covers that never downloaded, and templates incompatible with Bases.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to search book metadata, download covers, and track reading status in one flow that works with Bases card views.

relations.evidence: Multi-provider search — queries Open Library, Google Books, and OpenAlex, with configurable provider order
queries Open Library, Google Books, and OpenAlex, with configurable provider order and per-provider enable/disable toggles
OpenAlex is primarily a scholarly/academic metadata fallback and rarely returns cover images.
Supports Templater syntax if you have that plugin installed.

requires.name: OpenAlex contact email for polite-pool rate limits

summary: Book library plugin that searches Open Library, Google Books and OpenAlex, caches covers locally, and creates frontmatter-based book notes with status and ratings.
